body:
Track which mining hotspots the Commander has worked.

### What is wanted

A plan for storing hotspots per Commander.

Size: /issue-worker, Opus, high effort.

The jump callout names the system but not the fuel left in the main tank.

### What is wanted

Append the fuel left to the jump callout.

Size: /issue-worker, Sonnet, medium effort.

The panel shows the carrier's destination but not when it can jump again.

### What is wanted

A cooldown line under the carrier destination.

Size: /issue-worker, Sonnet, medium effort.

A fifth theme in dark red.

### What is wanted

A theme option named Dark red.

Size: /issue-worker, Sonnet, medium effort.

The Fleet tab lists ships in one long column.

### What is wanted

A grid layout, drawn in Claude Design first.

Size: /issue-worker, Sonnet, medium effort.

A route planner for exobiology samples.

### What is wanted

A plan for where the planner's data comes from.

Size: /issue-worker, Opus, high effort.
